Her torso folds gently around the raised leg; one cheek rests in clear contact with the raised knee, her hands loosely circle the shin, and she looks directly into the camera with a quiet, intent expression. Retain the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, large brown eyes, soft pink lips, navy blazer, white shirt, plaid ribbon bow, dark pleated skirt, knee-high socks, and loafers. Frame from head to both shoes at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, with the desk edge forming a diagonal that keeps the elevated foot, knee, cheek contact, and grounded foot visible in one plane. A soft side window light grazes her cheek and knee together, reinforcing their contact against a clean green chalkboard. Preserve realistic anatomy, fabric folds, skin texture, and a calm after-class atmosphere.
